metadata.name: fetch
metadata.description: (url [, method] [, body]) - the network verb. Async; returns the response body text. Goes through the net gate (logged + allowlist-checked). The single sanctioned way a formula reaches the network. =fetch("https://example.com")

metadata.name: netlog
metadata.description: () - the traffic wiretap, surfaced. Snapshot of every network request through the gate (method, host, status / BLOCKED / ERR). Re-evaluate to refresh. =netlog()

metadata.name: netallow
metadata.description: ([host, ...]) - the whitelist, surfaced + edited. No args shows the current policy; with args DECLARES the allowlist as exactly those hosts (off-list fetches are blocked + logged). Default is allow-all. =netallow("api.anthropic.com")
